K01.drivers: Ordinary proportions, moderate shoulders, normal waist and hip taper, straight legs; profile shows a normal upright S-curve

K02.drivers: Average slim-to-medium build with typical segment relations; nothing unusual in profile

K03.drivers: Large belly projecting forward in profile with a deep trunk; limbs and skeleton otherwise human. Could be read as A, a heavier everyday human
axial_cues: slight forward lean of upper trunk

K04.drivers: Lean ordinary build, normal taper and proportions

K05.drivers: Ordinary build with slightly softer chest and hips; normal proportions

K06.drivers: Very broad shoulder line, heavy upper arms and a boxy trunk; thick thighs. Structure is still human, just heavy and muscular

K07.drivers: Slim ordinary build with a slightly forward-set chest in profile; within the normal range

K08.drivers: Barrel ribcage bulging strongly front and back in profile over a very narrow waist and small pelvis; thin limbs that are long relative to the trunk; arms hang forward of the body; leg profile has an unusual S-shaped contour, with the knee and calf bulging
limb_cues: arms carried forward of the trunk
S-curved leg profile with prominent knee/calf
narrow thigh gap and spindly legs

K09.drivers: Very wide, straight-sided trunk with almost no waist, broad shoulders and a rounded upper back in profile; legs fairly thin relative to the trunk. Could be a stocky-race body but reads mostly as an extreme heavy-set human

K10.drivers: Pronounced belly and deep trunk in profile; otherwise human proportions. Same type as K03

K11.drivers: Same structure as K08: a strongly bulging, keeled thorax and hump-like back over a narrow waist and pelvis; thin, long limbs; forward-hanging arms; S-curved leg profile
limb_cues: knee/calf bulge in the profile leg contour

K12.drivers: Ordinary medium build, normal taper and profile

distinguishing_features: I see only one clearly non-human group, K08 and K11. They share a barrel/keeled thorax that bulges front and back, a pinched waist, a small pelvis, thin elongated limbs carried forward, and an S-curved leg profile, which separates them from every other body. K09 (and maybe K06) could be a stocky second type with a wide, waistless column trunk, but the evidence is weak, so I scored them B rather than C.
